sentences.text: Hoy vino al hospital un donante de sangre muy joven.
sentences.en: A very young blood donor came to the hospital today.
sentences.ko: 오늘 아주 젊은 헌혈자가 병원에 왔어요.

sentences.text: El tío de Marta es donante de órganos.
sentences.en: Marta's uncle is an organ donor.
sentences.ko: 마르타의 삼촌은 장기 기증자예요.

sentences.text: La enfermera Nuria le preguntó por su grupo sanguíneo.
sentences.en: Nurse Nuria asked him about his blood type.
sentences.ko: 간호사 누리아가 그에게 혈액형을 물었어요.

sentences.text: La presión sanguínea del abuelo es normal.
sentences.en: Grandpa's blood pressure is normal.
sentences.ko: 할아버지 혈압은 정상이에요.

sentences.text: Después de la extracción, el chico se empezó a marear.
sentences.en: After the blood draw, the boy started to feel dizzy.
sentences.ko: 피를 뽑은 뒤 그 남자애는 어지러워지기 시작했어요.

sentences.text: En el barco, Pablo se mareó un poco.
sentences.en: On the boat, Pablo got a little seasick.
sentences.ko: 배에서 파블로는 멀미가 조금 났어요.

sentences.text: Nuria le dijo que estaba bien físicamente, solo cansado.
sentences.en: Nuria told him he was physically fine, just tired.
sentences.ko: 누리아는 그가 몸은 괜찮고 피곤할 뿐이라고 했어요.

sentences.text: Después de correr, el tío estaba agotado físicamente.
sentences.en: After running, the uncle was physically exhausted.
sentences.ko: 달리고 나서 삼촌은 몸이 녹초가 됐어요.

sentences.text: Un paciente se cayó y se golpeó el codo.
sentences.en: A patient fell and hit his elbow.
sentences.ko: 한 환자가 넘어져서 팔꿈치를 부딪쳤어요.

sentences.text: El niño se golpeó el codo con la mesa.
sentences.en: The boy hit his elbow on the table.
sentences.ko: 아이가 식탁에 팔꿈치를 부딪쳤어요.

sentences.text: El paciente tenía un corte pequeño en la palma de la mano.
sentences.en: The patient had a small cut on the palm of his hand.
sentences.ko: 환자는 손바닥에 작은 상처가 있었어요.

sentences.text: La niña leyó la palma de la mano de su amiga en broma.
sentences.en: The girl read her friend's palm as a joke.
sentences.ko: 여자아이가 장난으로 친구의 손금을 봐 줬어요.

sentences.text: La doctora revisó un lunar del brazo de Nuria.
sentences.en: The doctor checked a mole on Nuria's arm.
sentences.ko: 의사가 누리아 팔의 점을 살펴봤어요.

sentences.text: La abuela tiene un lunar en la mejilla.
sentences.en: Grandma has a mole on her cheek.
sentences.ko: 할머니 볼에는 점이 하나 있어요.

sentences.text: El apoyo psicológico es importante para los pacientes.
sentences.en: Psychological support is important for patients.
sentences.ko: 환자에게는 심리적 지지가 중요해요.

sentences.text: Un estudio psicológico dice que reír ayuda a vivir más.
sentences.en: A psychological study says laughing helps you live longer.
sentences.ko: 한 심리학 연구에 따르면 웃으면 더 오래 산대요.

sentences.text: El centro ayuda a cada drogadicto que quiere cambiar su vida.
sentences.en: The center helps every drug addict who wants to change their life.
sentences.ko: 그 센터는 삶을 바꾸고 싶어 하는 중독자를 돕고 있어요.

sentences.text: La película trata de un drogadicto que se recupera gracias a su familia.
sentences.en: The film is about a drug addict who recovers thanks to his family.
sentences.ko: 영화는 가족 덕분에 회복하는 중독자 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Cuando se fue la luz, el generador del hospital se encendió solo.
sentences.en: When the power went out, the hospital generator turned on by itself.
sentences.ko: 정전이 되자 병원 발전기가 저절로 켜졌어요.

sentences.text: El abuelo usa un generador cuando se corta la luz en el pueblo.
sentences.en: Grandpa uses a generator when the power goes out in the village.
sentences.ko: 마을에 전기가 끊기면 할아버지는 발전기를 써요.

sentences.text: Los accidentes domésticos son muy comunes con niños pequeños.
sentences.en: Household accidents are very common with small children.
sentences.ko: 어린아이가 있으면 집 안 사고가 아주 흔해요.

sentences.text: El perro es un animal doméstico muy fiel.
sentences.en: The dog is a very loyal domestic animal.
sentences.ko: 개는 아주 충직한 반려동물이에요.

sentences.text: La abuela de Nuria falleció en paz el invierno pasado.
sentences.en: Nuria's grandmother passed away peacefully last winter.
sentences.ko: 누리아의 할머니는 지난겨울 편안히 돌아가셨어요.

sentences.text: El vecino del pueblo falleció a una edad muy avanzada.
sentences.en: The village neighbor passed away at a very old age.
sentences.ko: 마을 이웃은 아주 많은 나이에 세상을 떠났어요.

sentences.text: A Nuria le disgusta la gente que no respeta las normas.
sentences.en: Nuria dislikes people who don't respect the rules.
sentences.ko: 누리아는 규칙을 안 지키는 사람을 싫어해요.

sentences.text: A Marta le disgustó mucho la respuesta de su hermano.
sentences.en: Marta was very upset by her brother's answer.
sentences.ko: 마르타는 동생의 대답이 몹시 언짢았어요.

sentences.text: Para entretener a los niños enfermos, Nuria les cuenta cuentos.
sentences.en: To entertain the sick children, Nuria tells them stories.
sentences.ko: 누리아는 아픈 아이들을 즐겁게 해 주려고 이야기를 들려줘요.

sentences.text: Los abuelos saben entretener a los nietos con juegos sencillos.
sentences.en: Grandparents know how to entertain their grandchildren with simple games.
sentences.ko: 할머니 할아버지는 간단한 놀이로 손주들을 즐겁게 해 줄 줄 알아요.

sentences.text: Un niño le hizo una burla a Nuria y ella se rió.
sentences.en: A boy made fun of Nuria and she laughed.
sentences.ko: 한 아이가 누리아를 놀리자 그녀는 웃었어요.

sentences.text: La burla nunca es una buena forma de educar.
sentences.en: Mockery is never a good way to teach.
sentences.ko: 놀림은 결코 좋은 교육 방법이 아니에요.

sentences.text: Nuria no guarda rencor a nadie.
sentences.en: Nuria doesn't hold a grudge against anyone.
sentences.ko: 누리아는 누구에게도 앙심을 품지 않아요.

sentences.text: Guardar rencor solo te hace daño a ti.
sentences.en: Holding a grudge only hurts you.
sentences.ko: 앙심을 품으면 너만 다쳐.

sentences.text: En la telenovela, un médico intenta seducir a una enfermera.
sentences.en: In the soap opera, a doctor tries to seduce a nurse.
sentences.ko: 드라마에서 한 의사가 간호사를 유혹하려고 해요.

sentences.text: Según la abuela, un perfume no basta para seducir a nadie.
sentences.en: According to Grandma, a perfume isn't enough to seduce anyone.
sentences.ko: 할머니 말로는 향수만으로는 아무도 유혹할 수 없대요.
